The services

Everything a good chair should offer.

Six services, done the traditional way. Adult and young adult haircuts include a hairline edge up and beard trimming.

No. 01

Haircut

A clean, tailored cut finished with a hairline edge up and beard trim.

No. 02

Straight-edge shave

A close, smooth shave done by hand with a straight edge.

No. 03

Beard trimming

Length taken down evenly and lines tidied for a neat beard.

No. 04

Beard work

Shaping, sculpting, and sharp line work to give a beard real form.

No. 05

Hair color

Color applied to refresh, cover gray, or change things up.

No. 06

Kids haircut

A patient, friendly cut sized for younger clients.
